summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification of the new admin Settings Danger Zone wipe flow: backend auth/confirm/password guardrails passed, UI panel opened and successfully triggered the wipe, and seeded demo users/orders/contests/leaderboard rows were removed. However the fix is not complete: admin-visible winner audit logs are not wiped, and /api/admin/stats still reports preserved staff in users instead of the requested zero user count.

critical.issue: The wipe endpoint deletes audit_log but /api/admin/audit-logs reads winner_audit. A seeded winner_audit demo marker remained visible in the Admin Audit Logs response after wipe, so demo audit data can still appear in the admin panel.

minor.issue: After wipe, stats correctly returned zero for contests/orders/tickets/revenue/prize_pool/KYC, but users remained non-zero because preserved staff accounts are counted. The review request expected users=0 after wipe. In the final clean preview state it returns users=1 for the super_admin.

action_items: Add winner_audit to the wipe operation or otherwise purge all collections shown by /api/admin/audit-logs, then retest that old demo audit activity is no longer visible.
Clarify/fix /api/admin/stats user count after wipe: either return regular-player count only or adjust the acceptance criteria if preserved staff should be counted.

Self-test the full production-admin clean-state outcome after changes: settings wipe report, users only staff, orders empty, contests empty, leaderboard empty, audit logs free of demo markers, and dashboard stats matching the intended clean-state numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: _WIPEABLE_COLLECTIONS in /app/backend/routers/admin_routes.py includes audit_log but not winner_audit, while /api/admin/audit-logs reads winner_audit and support_cases. This mismatch leaves admin-visible audit data behind.
/api/admin/stats counts all documents in users, so it includes preserved super_admin/admin/operator/support accounts after wipe. This conflicts with the regression sanity item that expected users=0.
seed_data_creation: Created QA-only demo users, staff users, wallets, and one document in each requested wipe collection for backend testing; created one demo user/order/contest/ticket/leaderboard row for UI testing. Final cleanup left preview DB with only the super_admin user plus its reset wallet; tested demo collections and winner_audit are empty.

rca_of_the_issue: The implementation wipes many transactional/demo collections and regular users, but it missed winner_audit, which is the collection actually surfaced by /api/admin/audit-logs for winner-selection audit activity. Therefore users can still see demo audit data in the admin panel after pressing Wipe Demo Data. Separately, dashboard stats count preserved staff in users, so a clean staff-only environment still shows a non-zero user count.
